phases.title: CLI foundation: machine output, strict config and compatibility
phases.initial_body:
Parent: #90. Local specification: specs/011-cli-feature-parity/p0/.

Status: design G1 passed; skeleton/red tests next.

Freeze and implement core JSON/errors/exits/config precedence/bootstrap; preserve all nine legacy commands. P0 design G1 passed; skeleton/red/G2/G3 and runtime remain pending.

Traceability: FR01–03/09/10; SC01–03/09/10.

- [ ] Exact behavior/input/output/limits and acceptance cases reviewed (G1).
- [ ] Skeleton and genuine acceptance-red evidence independently reviewed (G2).
- [ ] Reused components/seams independently reviewed (G3).
- [ ] Real CLI implementation, focused green and affected regressions.
- [ ] Deterministic mechanism/stress checks; live applicability/observations reported separately.
- [ ] Final independent review, command manifest and docs reconciled.

No completion claim from planning alone. No paid inference or model downloads; sequential bounded checks. Dependencies and actual progress are tracked in specs/011-cli-feature-parity/status.md and tasks.md.
